body:
The Dinh Cau Festival is held at Dinh Cau shrine at the Duong Dong river mouth on the 15th–16th day of the 10th lunar month. In 2026 that is **Monday, November 23 and Tuesday, November 24**.

## What is listed

- Palanquin procession and boat racing are listed as activities.
- The detailed programme and times have **not been announced yet (unconfirmed)**.
- Whether admission is free is **unconfirmed**.

Please check local announcements closer to the date.

Source: Phu Quoc Pulse event listing (phuquocpulse.com)

body:
TIDES is listed as the inaugural edition of an electronic music festival on Phu Quoc's shores, bringing together about 30 local and international DJs.

## Details listed

- **When:** from Dec 31, 2026 at 20:00 to Jan 2, 2027 (listing shows end at 08:00)
- **Where:** Happy Buddha, 92 Tran Hung Dao, Duong Dong
- **Stages:** an open-air beach stage and an indoor stage
- **Tickets:** early-bird tier exists, but prices are **unconfirmed** — check the ticketing page

Source: Resident Advisor event listing (ra.co/events/2504709)
